Spring is finally here, and with it the Steam Spring Sale arrives as well! 
As the world awakens from its winter slumber, there's no better time to immerse yourself in the vibrant worlds brought to you by Untold Tales.

Picture this: the sun streaming through your window, a gentle breeze whispering promises of adventure, and a vast array of games just waiting to be explored. Whether you're in the mood for heart-pounding action, immersive storytelling, or mind-bending puzzles, we've got you covered.

From gripping narratives to pulse-pounding gameplay, our portfolio has something for everyone: UNTOLD TALES SPRING SALE!

notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png

Hello Midgardians!

ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree, the upcoming title from our friends at Untold Tales and Wildboy Studios, launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

FIGHT TO THE BEAT

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

A TASTE OF THE TUNES

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented James Shuar also know in the electronica scene as Luminist, as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow (The Outer Wilds). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> 

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales

notes.title: Art Book from the game is ready for the premiere
notes.content:
Do you wonder where visuals from Dr Livingstone, I Presume? have their roots? Let us introduce the place, where you will find out. Examine each line and each color that marked the final direction. Everything you will see inside the game it comes from right here. The most beautiful concept arts collected on several dozen pages. Each page arranged with due diligence. Room after room, riddle after riddle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37898672/624debdfddb567f2a4af705b11b61527e43be840.png

Creating the visual language for "Dr. Livingstone, I Presume?" was as exciting as it was demanding. The key aspect and the first step was to define the boundaries in which I will move in this aspect, the rules that we will have to follow throughout production in order to obtain a coherent vision, and then its implementation. 

Historical background, title hero - David Livingstone and the continent of Africa were the first key starting points here. Another one was low poly style, which we chose for the game. 

So it was necessary to dress the simplicity of the form with something that would break it, make it unique, and this is where hand-painted textures come in. With all this in mind, I expanded these concepts, took inspiration from aspects rooted in the real world. It was clear that we don't seek 1:1 realism here, that we desire to create an audiovisual experience that is unique. 

I wanted the house of David Livingstone (which from the very beginning was supposed to be a "strange house") not only to be an arena we will move around, but also to become a kind of story hero, almost a personage expressing his character, history and emotions that will intertwine with both the narrative and the gameplay to finally offer something, I hope, worth experiencing and remembering.

~ Paweł Ruszkowski, Main Concept Artist

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37898672/7e1ff5148dca82f4fe14e9decea7a88e72418c0f.png

An exquisite art book from the game is waiting to feed your artistic needs
You will get it as a gift for the game premiere on May 20, 2021. How do you like it?

notes.title: Dr Livingstone, I Presume? will release on May 20, 2021
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Dr Livingstone, I Presume? will release on May 20, 2021!

Getting closer and closer... to the thrilling journey through the home of the African traveler. As well as to experiencing the touching story of looking for a friend. 

[previewyoutube=Xziod7mN3S4;full][/previewyoutube]

How will this journey end?
You will find out on May 20, 2021.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37898672/2f37513bfb7d01695948a3e0e145e6d474952d2e.png

We create in full swing
Our game designer watches over every detail of every puzzle so that they can delight you soon:
"One of the many challenges that we had to face during production was designing puzzles with the realities of 19th century Africa in mind. The key in this aspect was cooperation on the design-art line, thanks to which it was possible to fill the rooms with puzzles waiting for players. Of course, it was not without research that broadened our knowledge."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37898672/53a2837d846e8db538210029ec36748e7b4a4ba1.png

All the difficulties you encounter in the game cannot stop you in your mission to find a friend. We will not reveal how the search ends, but our Narrative Designer puts his whole heart into making the plot surprise you:
“There is an interesting anecdote connected with the plot. I remember when I joined the project and my boss briefly told me the Livingstone and Stanley story, I thought to myself: "Wow, they made it up really nicely." And then it turned out that it was a true story! In the game, we finally decided to add our alternative version of events after the meeting of both men, while maintaining a historical background consistent with the facts and respect for the achievements of both characters."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37898672/383961d2b37d81c4f3f84ff1824d7ed02fd94f1d.png

An artistic gem among logic games
In two months and one day, you'll find six captivating locations filled with riddles, narrative collectibles, beautiful music and a fusion of the African and English world of the 19th century.

Stay tuned!
